title: blackbox is bin-only for release test targeting
content: `blackbox` is currently a bin-only crate (`[[bin]] blackboxd`, `[[bin]] bro`) with no `[lib]` target, so `cargo test --release --lib` fails with `no library targets found in package `blackbox``. For the unit tests living under `#[cfg(test)]` in `src/main.rs`, use `cargo test --release --bin blackboxd` (or `cargo test --bin blackboxd`) instead.
